title: 9 April 1965: Filming: Help!
content:
The Beatles filmed an unused scene for Help! on this day. It was set in a warehouse, and also involved Superindendent Gluck (played by Patrick Cargill), seven policemen, and a dozen gang members led by Clang (Leo McKern).

Page last updated: 16 May 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2019: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Zepp, Nagoya
  • 2011: Publishers announced for The Lennon Letters
  • 2003: Paul McCartney live: Manchester Evening News Arena, Manchester
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Rupp Arena, Lexington
  • 1974: Paul McCartney pitches Cold Cuts to Capitol Records
  • 1973: John Lennon, George Harrison and Ringo Starr attend Capitol Records party
  • 1973: US single release: My Love by Paul McCartney and Wings
  • 1971: Recording: I Lie Around by Wings; Now Hear This Song Of Mine by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1970: Apple denies that Paul McCartney has left The Beatles
  • 1969: The Beatles are photographed in London
  • 1967: Paul McCartney flies from Denver to Los Angeles
  • 1965: UK single release: Ticket To Ride
  • 1964: Filming: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Gaumont State Cinema, Kilburn, London
  • 1963: Television: Tuesday Rendezvous
  • 1963: Radio: Pop Inn
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Top Ten Club, Hamburg
